lines.zh: 甲片相碰，我列队向前走。
lines.en: Armour plates clatter as I advance in file.

lines.zh: 长戟扛在肩上，步子很齐。
lines.en: Halberd on my shoulder, my steps stay even.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间的小路巡过去。
lines.en: I patrol along the woodland track.

lines.zh: 面前一扇木门，我一撞就开。
lines.en: A wooden door ahead; one shove and it's open.

lines.zh: 队列不能乱，我盯着前一个人的背。
lines.en: The line must hold; I watch the back ahead.
The Inquisition's banner snaps in the wind.

lines.zh: 甲靴压过草地，草都折了。
lines.en: My boots press the grass flat.

lines.zh: 我绕开那摊水，甲不能湿。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle; armour mustn't rust.

lines.zh: 转弯时我慢了半拍，又跟上。
lines.en: I lose half a beat on the turn, then catch up.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把路面踩实。
lines.en: Step by step I firm up the ground.

lines.zh: 前面是密林，我把戟压低。
lines.en: Dense woods ahead; I lower the halberd.

lines.zh: 甲缝里进了根草，我懒得管。
lines.en: A blade of grass is in my seams; I ignore it.
I take the outermost file.

lines.zh: 木栅栏挡路，我直接撞开。
lines.en: A fence blocks me; I break through.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，鸟都惊了。
lines.en: My steps are heavy; the birds startle.

lines.zh: 队形散了一点，我退回去补位。
lines.en: The formation loosened; I step back into place.
I stand at rest, halberd tip down.
A breath sits stifled inside my plate.

lines.zh: 我数着林子里第几声鸟叫
lines.en: I count the birdsong in the wood.
Under the visor, only breathing.
I slowly switch the halberd to my other hand.

lines.zh: 一根树枝落下来，我没动。
lines.en: A branch falls; I don't move.
No one in the file speaks.
I stare at the treeline without blinking.
There's an old score in my plate.
I'm waiting for the order.
Wind passes through my visor; it's cold.
I bring my heels together.
Halt. State who you are.
I lift the halberd tip half an inch.
You don't look like the Inquisition.
You're armed. Hand it over.
I look at you from behind the visor.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势不像平民。
lines.en: You don't walk like a commoner.
I hold still and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的手一直没离开刀柄
lines.en: Your hand hasn't left that hilt.
This road is closed.
I square my body toward you.

lines.zh: 甲被敲了一下，我退了半步。
lines.en: A blow rings on my plate; I step back.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙把面甲掰回来
lines.en: I grit my teeth and twist the visor back.

lines.zh: 肋下的甲缝在往外冒血
lines.en: Blood wells out at the seam under my ribs.

lines.zh: 肩甲的一颗扣子被砸飞
lines.en: A clasp flew off my pauldron.
I make no sound and reset my stance.
The halberd is still in my hand.
A plate has a dent in it.
I drop to one knee, then rise.

lines.zh: 这一下打在护颈的缝上
lines.en: That one found the gap at my gorget.
The formation holds; I step back in.
Rations? Put them on the ground.
I don't touch rations without a stamp.
The visor's in the way; I can't eat.
Push it over and I'll look.
My hand hasn't left the halberd.
This supply goes to the file.
What do you want for the food?

lines.zh: 我的份今早已经领过了
lines.en: I drew my share this morning.
Not bad. I'll remember it.
Leave it there. Don't come closer.
You hit my plate and go back two steps.

lines.zh: 甲底下的脚跟钉在土里
lines.en: My heels are planted under the plate.
Clear the way; don't block the file.
My armor drops and I shoulder you back half a step.
That knock made my plates ring.

lines.zh: 你站稳，我不重复第二遍。
lines.en: Steady yourself; I won't repeat that.
I turn and give you half a step.
The armour is heavy; I can't stop quickly.
Keep your hands off my breastplate.
The line can't stop; I go around.
That isn't in my duty.
I lift my visor for a moment.
Armour goes cold; people don't.

lines.zh: 我记得加入审判庭之前的名字。
lines.en: I remember the name I had before.
Comrades don't need many words.
I lean the halberd against a tree.
I'm off duty tonight.

lines.zh: 有人替我守夜，我就能睡。
lines.en: Someone watches the night, so I can sleep.

lines.zh: 我伸手，只是碰了一下护手。
lines.en: I reach out and only touch a gauntlet.
Tomorrow we form up again.
I bend and my plates creak.

lines.zh: 这枚徽记掉了，我捡起来。
lines.en: This badge dropped; I pick it up.
A broken halberd — I weigh it.
It goes to stores; I've noted it.
I hook it back onto my belt.
This cloth is too torn; leave it.
I flick it up with the halberd tip.
Armoured hands don't grip small things well.
It goes to the file as captured goods.
The number says friendly; I set it aside.

lines.zh: 那边有个影子贴着树干
lines.en: A shadow hugs the trunk over there.
I turn the halberd, blade forward.
That's not a person's gait.
The file closes up; I take the front.
I drop my weight and take a long step.
The order is now.

lines.zh: 它的后颈露在戟尖前面
lines.en: Its nape is bare before my halberd.
I'm sweating under the plate.

lines.zh: 我锁定它的腿，先废了再说。
lines.en: I pick its legs; disable first.

lines.zh: 它跑不掉，林子就这么宽。
lines.en: It can't run; the woods are this narrow.

lines.zh: 我的戟尖压着草，往前推
lines.en: Halberd tip low over the grass, I push on.

lines.zh: 它绕左，我一个短步就拦住。
lines.en: It goes left; one short step cuts it off.
The halberd is long; it can't get inside.
It snarls; I don't answer.
Armour is slow, but it leaves no gap.
I drive it out past the treeline.
I hear its breathing clearly.

lines.zh: 再进一步就进我的戟圈
lines.en: One more step and you're in my reach.

lines.zh: 我把戟横在胸前等它扑
lines.en: Halberd across my chest, I wait for the lunge.
My comrades are behind me; I can't fall back.
My halberd sweeps and the wood goes silent.

lines.zh: 戟尖扎进去，甲也跟着压上。
lines.en: The tip goes in and my weight follows.
I strike its ribs with the shaft.
I drive my pauldron in with a dull clang.
The blade rises and comes down again.
The phalanx taught me this one.
It hits my plate and slides off.
I step back and reset my stance.
It falls and I pin it with the halberd.
Blood spatters my visor.

lines.zh: 甲片一片片扣好，我站直了。
lines.en: Plate by plate, I fasten on and stand.

lines.zh: 面甲合上前，我看了最后一眼。
lines.en: I take one last look before the visor closes.

lines.zh: 我落在林间，脚把土压出坑。
lines.en: I land in the wood and my boots dent the soil.
The Inquisition does not explain itself.

lines.zh: 队列里空了一个位，我补上。
lines.en: A place in the file was empty; I take it.
It's quiet — wrongly quiet.
I pull the halberd up out of the soil.
My armour catches the moonlight.
The banner isn't raised yet.
First I read this stretch of woods.
The iron gets hot and I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 甲太重，落地时我崴了脚。
lines.en: Armour is heavy; I land badly and twist an ankle.

lines.zh: 水从甲缝灌进去，我往下沉。
lines.en: Water floods the seams and drags me down.
The blast peels half my plate away.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的胸甲上。
lines.en: An arrow wedges in my breastplate.
Something passed straight through the plate.
An empty belly makes the armour twice as heavy.

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁甲走遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the iron and through me.

lines.zh: 脚下空掉，甲带着我往下。
lines.en: The floor vanished and the armour takes me down.
